title: Advancing Clinical Trial Outcome Prediction with Domain-Specific Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.41710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical trial failures are a major barrier to efficient drug development, incurring substantial costs and delaying patient access to effective therapies. Structured approaches such as the Hierarchical Interaction Network (HINT) predict trial outcomes by explicitly modelling interactions between drugs, diseases and protocols, but make limited use of the free text in trial registrations. We evaluate two domain-specific language models, BioBERT (108M parameters) and BioMistral (7B parameters), for phase-level outcome prediction on the TOP benchmark (12,477 trials), representing each trial as text built from ten ClinicalTrials.gov fields. We compare fine-tuning (full fine-tuning for BioBERT, low-rank adaptation for BioMistral) with probing, in which the pretrained model is frozen and only a lightweight classifier is trained on its embeddings. translated_title: 利用领域特定大语言模型推进临床试验结局预测
translated_abstract: 临床试验失败是高效药物研发的主要障碍，会造成巨额成本并延误患者获得有效治疗。诸如分层交互网络（HINT）等结构化方法通过显式建模药物、疾病与试验方案之间的交互来预测试验结局，但对试验注册中的自由文本利用有限。我们在TOP基准（12,477项试验）上评估了两个领域特定语言模型——BioBERT（1.08亿参数）和BioMistral（70亿参数）——用于分期别的结局预测，将每项试验表示为由ClinicalTrials.gov十个字段构建的文本。我们比较了微调（BioBERT采用全量微调，BioMistral采用低秩适配）与探测两种方式，后者中预训练模型被冻结，仅在其嵌入上训练一个轻量级分类器。在各分期的保留测试集上，所有四种语言模型变体均取得了更高的ROC-AUC（0……
tldr: 该研究将领域特定大语言模型（BioBERT与BioMistral）应用于临床试验结局预测，通过利用试验注册中的自由文本，在TOP基准上取得了优于结构化方法（如HINT）的预测性能。
en_tdlr: Domain-specific language models (BioBERT and BioMistral), applied via fine-tuning or probing to free-text trial registrations, outperform structured approaches like HINT in predicting clinical trial outcomes on the TOP benchmark.
